war_summary: War 139 is on day 86 with no winner and conquest active. The front is split: Colonial forces hold the majority of strategic bases across many regions (e.g., Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields, Dead Lands, Mooring County, Olavis Wake, Onyx, Stema Landing), while Wardens hold consolidated blocks (Basin Sionnach, Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Marban Hollow, Reaching Trail, Stlican Shelf, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse). The heaviest sustained pressure is in Callahans Passage (~61k casualties, Warden 8/10 bases), Clahstra (Warden 6/8 with 21 capture events in 24h), Dead Lands (Colonial 10/11 with ~77k casualties), Mooring County (Colonial 10/12 with 22 events in 24h), Oarbreaker (Warden 5/9 with 22 events in 24h and very recent captures at 05:32), Stlican Shelf (Warden 9/9 with 26 events in 24h and accelerating casualties), and Speaking Woods (Warden 7/8 with accelerating casualties). Several other regions show zero recent capture events and stable ownership. Uncertainty remains highest where recent capture events are frequent and casualty rates are accelerating, especially near the cutoff.
